none: PAS NLM-1541A2: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I from Winterton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IM[-]TET[--]AVG. Reverse description: Figure resembling Sol advancing left, arm raised. Reverse inscription: [--] V V[--]. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 3.13gms, die axis: 6
